hwp5write.export.label: HWP document (.hwp)
hwp5write.err.notFromHwp: This document was not opened from an HWP file, so it cannot be saved as HWP. Save it as HWPX instead.
hwp5write.err.noOriginal: The original HWP file content was not found, so it cannot be saved as HWP. Save it as HWPX instead.
hwp5write.export.hint2: The HWP file you opened with your text edits · documents with other edits (formatting, pictures …) are saved as HWPX
hwp5write.format.level2: Opens paragraphs, character formats, tables and pictures · saved as HWP unedited or with text edits, as HWPX otherwise
hwp5write.err.otherEdit: A document with edits other than text (character or paragraph formats, pictures, shapes, table layout, page setup, headers / footers, notes, comments or tracked changes) cannot be saved as HWP. Saving as HWPX keeps your edits and the original formatting.
